public_encodings.injectivity_argument: Fixed-width typed concatenations have a unique inverse. BE u16 pairing is invertible given fixed byte length and enforced zero low8 in odd final field. Fixed field-array widths admit unique slicing. Domain, version, length and chunk index are explicit; mandatory 1 padding gives a unique message/chunk boundary. This is injectivity of encoding, not a claim that finite digests or chained compression are injective or collision resistant. Cross-role input overlap is not ruled out by this argument and remains in security review.

optimized_arithmetic_bounds: Inputs canonical<p. External matrix sums <=32p times fixed small coefficients. Internal sum<=32p plus (p-1)^2 <2^63. All generated Yul intermediates fit uint256 without wrap; every stored state lane reduced modp before next round.
